rationale: Tests understanding of the four phases of the disaster management cycle as described in the 'Disaster Management Cycle' content block — a core structural concept for CM13.1.

Verifies recall of the legislative foundation of India's disaster management authority — the Disaster Management Act 2005 and NDMA — from the 'National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA)' content block.

Tests application of START triage colour coding and ICS principles from the 'Principles of Disaster Response: Incident Command and Triage' content block — directly aligned with CM13.3 response competency.
Tests understanding of decontamination zone sequencing from the 'Medical Countermeasures and Decontamination in Man-Made Disasters' content block — critical for safe CBRN response (CM13.5).
